义项: 动词 divest X of Y 去除 X 身上附着的 Y（此处剥去知识的艰涩外衣）
动词 divest 剥售资产、撤资；反义 invest，前缀 di-/dis- 表「去掉」

例句.英文: The great men of culture are those who have had a passion for diffusing, for making prevail, for carrying from one end of society to the other, the best knowledge, the best ideas of their time; who have labored to divest knowledge of all that was harsh, uncouth, difficult, abstract, professional, exclusive; to humanise it, to make it efficient outside the clique of the cultivated and learned, yet still remaining the best knowledge and thought of the time, and a true source, therefore, of sweetness and light.
例句.原书高亮: labored to divest knowledge of all
例句.中文: 文化伟人热衷于传播：把时代最好的知识与思想从社会的一端送到另一端；他们努力剥去知识身上生硬、粗鄙、艰深、抽象、专业化、排他的一切，使它人文化，使它能在有学养者的小圈子之外同样生效，却仍不失为时代最好的知识与思想，并因此成为「甜美与光明」的真正源泉。

义项: 动词 （布、帘）松垂地披覆、悬挂（curtains draped so as to…）
动词 (引申义) drape A over B 把…搭在…上；n. drapery 帷幔，真题与 sombre、embossed 共写室内沉闷

例句.英文: … those heavy curtains draped so as to half exclude the light of the sun.
例句.原书高亮: heavy curtains draped so as to
例句.中文: ……那些厚重的窗帘垂挂着，恰好挡去一半的阳光。

义项: 动词 源自；发源于（emanate from：由…产生 / 发出）
动词 （光、气味、声音）散发；放射
搭配说明: emanation — n. 散发（物）
emanate ≠ emancipate — 形近异义：后者是「解放」
originate / stem from — v. 起源于 / 源自于——近义

例句.英文: Citing cases as distinct as Jamaica and Mauritius, proponents of modernization theory hold the inverse, that so called Weberian bureaucracies emanate from capitalist growth.
例句.原书高亮: so called Weberian bureaucracies emanate from capitalist growth
例句.中文: 现代化理论的支持者以牙买加、毛里求斯等迥异的案例为据，持相反观点：所谓韦伯式官僚体制源自资本主义增长。

义项: 动词 在表面压出 / 雕出凸起图案（embossed wallpapers 压花墙纸）
[构词] em-（使…进入）+ boss（凸起）→ emboss；n. embossing 浮雕工艺

例句.英文: … those embossed, but sombre wallpapers hung up; those heavy curtains draped so as to half exclude the light of the sun.
例句.中文: ……那些压花却阴沉的墙纸挂了起来；那些厚重的窗帘垂挂着，恰好挡去一半的阳光。

义项: 副词 以经验为依据地；实证地（empirically testable / derived）
[辨析] empirically（靠观测实证）≠ theoretically（靠理论推演）——SAT 科学类文章核心对立
搭配说明: empirical / empiricism — adj. 实证的 / n. 经验主义
拼形警示 — empirically 与 empire 词源无关：前者出自希腊 empeiria「经验」，后者出自拉丁 imperium「命令、统治」

例句.英文: In each country, unidirectional cycles among two, three, or four locations were empirically the most common pattern types; the graph shows each of these pattern types as a proportion of all pattern instances found for that country (e.g., the measured value for CI 3 in the graph, 0.12, indicates that the three-location pattern constituted 12% of all pattern instances in the Côte d’Ivoire data).
例句.原书高亮: were empirically the most common pattern types
例句.中文: 在每个国家，两、三或四地之间的单向循环在经验上都是最常见的模式类型；图中把这些模式类型各自占该国全部模式实例的比例展示了出来（例如图中 CI 3 的数值 0.12，表示三地模式占科特迪瓦数据全部模式实例的12%）。

例句.英文: Indeed, Susan Silbey has observed that "the meaning of the word 'culture'. is unstable." This uncertainty impedes formulating empirically testable claims about reality, which should be an aim of sociological research—a standard definition of culture is a worthy goal even if impossible to achieve, for the closer we come to one, the closer we come to reducing conceptual incoherence in the field.
例句.中文: 的确，Susan Silbey 观察到：「『文化』一词的含义是不稳定的。」这种不确定性妨碍了提出可实证检验的现实主张——这本应是社会学研究的目标；为文化确立一个标准定义即使不可能实现，也是值得追求的目标：离它越近，就越能减少该领域的概念混乱。

义项: 形容词 神秘莫测、难以索解的（purposely enigmatic nature 刻意写得扑朔迷离）
[构词] enigma n. 谜 → enigmatic adj.；注意与 enigmatic 同源的 enigma 已不在本词条重复计数

例句.英文: Identification of consecutive riddles’ boundaries based on content is difficult, given their purposely enigmatic nature, the challenges modern readers face in interpreting the archaic language of Old English, and damage to the manuscript.
例句.原书高亮: their purposely enigmatic nature, the challenges
例句.中文: 要依据内容判定相邻谜语的分界很难：它们本就刻意写得玄秘，现代读者解读古英语又障碍重重，加上手稿本身还有残损。

义项: 动词 使活跃；使生动；使更有生气（enliven the party / the discussion）
[构词] en-（使）+ live（活的）+ -n
搭配说明: enlivened — adj. 被点亮的；被赋予生气的
liven up — phr. 使热闹起来——口语近义
enliven ≠ enlighten — 形近异义：后者是「启发、开导」

例句.英文: The moss in the towering water oaks had become enlivened with a verdant sheen of silver and hung like festoons of carnival or like funeral decorations for the mourning of the dead.
例句.原书高亮: had become enlivened with a verdant sheen of silver
例句.中文: 高大的水栎上的苔藓被一层银中带翠的润泽点亮，像狂欢节的彩饰，又像为悼亡而悬挂的丧礼装饰，垂挂下来。

义项: 动词 以吸引力引诱某人去做（entice consumers to make spontaneous purchases）
动词 entice sb into / to do；n. enticement 诱惑物；与 lure 相比更偏「用好处打动」

例句.英文: External shopping cues are a type of marketing that uses obvious messaging—a display featuring a new product, for example, or a "buy one, get one free" offer—to entice consumers to make spontaneous purchases.
例句.中文: 外部购物线索是一类营销手段，用醒目的信息——比如陈列新品，或「买一送一」——诱使消费者临时起意下单。

例句.英文: To entice study participants, psychology researchers commonly offer a gift card or other compensation.
例句.中文: 为吸引研究参与者，心理学研究者通常会赠送礼品卡或提供其他报酬。

义项: 形容词 短暂的；转瞬即逝的（ephemeral art / fame / practice）
形容词 （昆虫）朝生暮死的；短命的
搭配说明: ephemerality — n. 短暂性
transient / fleeting — adj. 短暂的——近义
ephemeral ≠ eternal / permanent — 反义

例句.英文: Stenography's rapidly inscribed squiggles and dots would enable (in theory, at least) the precise capture in print of improvisations by performers that would otherwise be ephemeral.
例句.中文: 速记术那些迅速写下的潦草笔画与点线，至少在理论上能够把表演者的即兴创作精确付印——否则这些即兴之作转瞬即逝。

例句.英文: This may seem in tension with the role of cultural ambassador—how could static objects authentically represent an inherently ephemeral and dynamic practice?—but such a view is itself overly object-focused and neglects how Stevens strove to convey exactly those characteristics of ikaah as a cultural practice.
例句.中文: 这似乎与文化大使的角色相悖——静态之物如何能本真地代表一种本质上转瞬即逝、充满动感的实践？——但这种看法本身过度聚焦于物，忽视了 Stevens 正是着力传达 ikaah 作为文化实践的这些特质。

义项: 形容词 分集的；由若干片段组成的（episodic storytelling / structure）
形容词 (引申义) 偶发的；断断续续的（episodic memory 情景记忆）
搭配说明: episode — n. 一集；一个事件
episodically — adv. 断断续续地
serial / serialized — adj. 连载的——近义，真题亦现

例句.英文: Recognizing those limits, researchers turned to approaches that considered home viewing environments, built-in commercials, and episodic storytelling, as well as to audience studies using ethnographic methods that highlighted viewer participation.
例句.中文: 认识到这些局限后，研究者转向另一些思路，把家庭观看环境、内置广告插播与分集叙事纳入考量，并采用凸显观众参与的民族志方法做受众研究。

义项: 动词 作为…的典型 / 缩影（as epitomized by… 以…为代表）
[构词] epitome n. 典型、缩影 → epitomize；重音在第二音节，别与 epitaph（墓志铭）混

例句.英文: As epitomized by the house in Calle Pedro Loza in Guadalajara, many of Barragán's first projects integrated traditional Mexican building techniques into Mediterranean designs.
例句.中文: 以瓜达拉哈拉 Calle Pedro Loza 的住宅为代表，巴拉甘早期的许多项目都把墨西哥传统建造技艺融入了地中海式设计之中。

义项: 释义 轻盈空灵、似非人间的（ethereal qualities 空灵气质）
[辨析] 与 aerial 词源相近但不同：ethereal 出自希腊 aithēr「上层清气」，aerial 出自 aēr「空气」——ethereal 强调「轻盈空灵」，不是「空中的」

例句.英文: To conclude that this approach accounts for the ethereal qualities now synonymous with the Highwaymen aesthetic is tempting but inaccurate, as Hair's methods weren't universally practiced by his affiliates: Harold Newton, for example, painted with greater deliberateness but achieved the same effects.
例句.原书高亮: for the ethereal qualities now synonymous
例句.中文: 若就此断言这种方法造就了如今与「公路客」美学划等号的空灵气质，固然诱人却不确切：海尔的画法并未被同派画家普遍采用——例如 Harold Newton 下笔更为审慎，却达到了同样的效果。

义项: 形容词 evocative of 令人联想起…、唤起某种感受的
[构词] evoke v. 唤起 → evocative adj.；与 provocative（挑衅的）拼写近而义远

例句.英文: Evocative of African sculpture and American and Scandinavian folk art, these portraits feature flat, deliberately oversimplified figures in a vibrant but limited color palette.
例句.中文: 这些肖像令人联想到非洲雕塑以及美国、斯堪的纳维亚的民间艺术：人物被压平、被刻意简化，配色鲜明却克制。

义项: 动词 赋予……价值、抬高……的价值：把它当作有价值的东西来对待
动词 (引申义) （文本 / 文化分析）推崇、正面评价（valorize folk-art traditions 推崇民间艺术传统）
[构词] valor（价值）+ -ize（使……化）→「使具有价值」
搭配说明: valorization — n. 价值化、推崇
value — n./v. 价值；估价——同源词根 val-

例句.英文: Both texts valorize folk-art traditions, but Text 1 does so by emphasizing qualities that are intrinsic to folk art, whereas Text 2 makes reference to other modes of cultural production.
例句.中文: 两篇文章都推崇民间艺术传统，但文本一的做法是强调民间艺术内在的品质，而文本二则援引其他文化生产方式。

义项: 形容词 （艺术）以变形、粗笔触主观地表现内在体验，而非客观再现
名词 expressionist n. 表现主义画家；与 impressionist（印象派）常作为对照项出现

例句.英文: Turning away from landscapes painted in an expressionist style—a style that often involves using fluid, distorted shapes and thick, textured brushstrokes to express the artist's subjective experience of reality—Johnson began painting portraits of Black Americans in a bold new way.
例句.原书高亮: in an expressionist style—a style that
例句.中文: 约翰逊从表现主义风景画——那种常以流动扭曲的形体、厚重有肌理的笔触来传达艺术家主观现实体验的风格——转身，转而用一种大胆的新方式描绘美国黑人肖像。

义项: 动词 （使物种在某地）灭绝；根除（locally extirpated species 局部灭绝物种）
动词 切除；摘除
搭配说明: extirpation — n. （局部）灭绝；根除
extirpated ≠ extinct — extinct 是全球性灭绝，extirpated 是某地区内消失——生态类文章关键区分
eradicate — v. 根除——近义

例句.英文: To explore this question, scientists seeded restored HZs in Oregon’s Johnson Creek with stoneflies and other locally extirpated species.
例句.中文: 为探究这一问题，科学家在俄勒冈州约翰逊溪已修复的潜流带（HZ）投放了石蝇以及其他在当地已灭绝的物种。

例句.英文: Although this approach offers unique benefits, such as access to genomic data from extirpated populations, it remains a relatively underutilized resource because hDNA is often to some extent degraded, a situation not easily remediable under current methodological paradigms and with extant DNA extraction and analysis technologies.
例句.中文: 尽管这种方法有独特优势（例如获取已局部灭绝种群的基因组数据），它仍是相对未充分利用的资源：历史 DNA 往往有一定程度的降解，在现行方法论范式与现存 DNA 提取、分析技术下都不易补救。

义项: 形容词 外来的、与当前议题不相干的（extraneous information / details）
[辨析] 真题 None of them should be considered extraneous 是排除干扰项的典型措辞；反义 relevant / pertinent

例句.英文: None of them should be considered extraneous.
例句.中文: 它们之中没有任何一项应被视作无关紧要。

义项: 动词 由已知样本 / 趋势推及未知范围或未来（extrapolate from data）
[辨析] 与 interpolate（在已知点之间内插）相对；n. extrapolation，SAT 科学阅读推断题高频词

例句.英文: Extrapolating from parasite counts on Pacific herring and seven other fish species collected from Puget Sound from 1880 to 2019, Chelsea Wood et al. found that the abundance of three-host parasites, such as Lecithaster sp., negatively correlated with rising average annual sea temperatures; the abundance of two-host parasites, such as C. parophrysi, was largely stable.
例句.中文: Chelsea Wood 等人依据 1880 至 2019 年采自普吉特海湾的太平洋鲱及另外七种鱼类的寄生虫计数作外推，发现三宿主寄生虫（如 Lecithaster sp.）的丰度与年平均海温上升呈负相关，而两宿主寄生虫（如 C. parophrysi）的丰度大体稳定。

义项: 动词 （说话）结巴、支吾；（行动）犹豫、动摇
动词 (引申义) 衰退；蹒跚（the economy faltered）
搭配说明: faltering — adj. 犹豫的；摇摇欲坠的
falter ≠ falcon / filter — 形近异义
waver / hesitate — v. 动摇 / v. 迟疑——近义

例句.英文: They are meeting for the first time. The little girl was standing quite by herself when Nancy finally did approach her. “Are you Miss—Pollyanna?” she faltered.
例句.中文: 她们是第一次见面。南希终于走上前去时，那个小女孩正独自一人站着。「你是——波莉安娜小姐吗？」她迟疑地问道。

义项: 动词 装出（伤病、情绪），feign an injured wing 装作翅膀受伤
[辨析] 与 feint（佯攻）同源；动物行为学里 feign injury 是「拟伤诱敌」的固定术语

例句.英文: While observing birds for a biology class, a group of students noticed a lesser sand plover (Charadrius mongolus), a bird of the order Charadriiformes (shorebirds), slowly move away, make loud noises, and feign an injured wing as the group approached the bird's ground nest.
例句.原书高亮: noises, and feign an injured wing
例句.中文: 一节生物课上，学生观察鸟类时注意到一只小沙鸻（Charadrius mongolus，鸻形目涉禽）在人靠近地面巢穴时缓缓走开、大声鸣叫，并装出翅膀受伤的样子。

义项: 名词 预知；事先知道（foreknowledge of an outcome）
[构词] fore-（预先）+ knowledge
搭配说明: foretell / foretold — v. 预言——同族，真题另现
foreknowledge ≠ foresight — 后者是「远见」，不带「确知」义

例句.英文: Researchers investigated how enjoyment of a story is affected when it has been spoiled (when the reader has foreknowledge of an important plot development).
例句.原书高亮: the reader has foreknowledge of an important plot development
例句.中文: 研究者考察了当故事被剧透（读者事先知道了某个重要情节发展）时，阅读的乐趣会受到怎样的影响。

例句.英文: But complete foreknowledge of relevant conditions is generally unavailable, suggesting that a state of uncertainty ultimately prevails in which outcomes can be predicted but not definitively foretold.
例句.中文: 但对相关条件的完全预知通常不可得，这表明最终盛行的是一种不确定状态：结果可以被预测，却无法被断然预断。

义项: 动词 预言；预示（过去式 / 过去分词 foretold）
[构词] fore-（预先）+ tell
搭配说明: foretold — v. 过去分词——真题见于书名 Chronicle of a Death Foretold
foretell ≠ forecast — 后者偏「（数据）预测」
predict / forebode — v. 预测 / v. 预示——近义

例句.英文: And despite his popular reputation, García Márquez himself wrote several works of strict realism, including Chronicle of a Death Foretold.
例句.中文: 尽管马尔克斯以魔幻现实主义闻名，他本人也写过几部严格意义上的现实主义作品，其中包括《一桩事先张扬的凶杀案》。

义项: 形容词 （用度）俭省、不铺张的；How frugal is the Chariot 反讽「这辆车马何等俭省」
形容词 (引申义) （餐食）简单的 a frugal meal；n. frugality，与 parsimonious（过度吝啬）语气不同

例句.英文: There is no Frigate like a Book To take us Lands away Nor any Coursers like a Page Of prancing Poetry—This Traverse may the poorest take Without oppress of Toll ——How frugal is the Chariot That bears the Human soul.
例句.中文: 没有一艘快船能像一本书，带我们驶向远方；也没有任何骏马能像一页诗，载着人腾跃——这趟旅程连最穷的人也负担得起，不必受通行税的盘剥：承载人类灵魂的这辆车辇，是何等俭省。

义项: 名词 田里翻出的沟垄；引申为额上皱纹
动词 furrow one's brow 皱眉；真题 linked to the ploughed furrow 以「属于耕过的犁沟」写鼹鼠的乡土归属

例句.英文: As he hurried along, eagerly anticipating the moment when he would be at home again among the things he knew and liked, the Mole saw clearly that he was an animal of tilled field and hedge-row, linked to the ploughed furrow, the frequented pasture, the lane of evening lingerings, the cultivated garden-plot.
例句.中文: 鼹鼠匆匆赶路、满心盼着回到熟悉可亲的旧物之间，一路忽然看得明白：自己是属于耕地与树篱、与犁过的沟垄、常去的牧场、傍晚徘徊的小径和料理过的园圃的动物。

义项: 名词 美食学；烹饪法（City of Gastronomy 美食之都）
[构词] gastro-（胃、食）+ -nomy（…学、法）
搭配说明: gastronomic / gastronome — adj. 美食的 / n. 美食家
gastronomy ≠ gastric — 后者是「胃的」
culinary — adj. 烹饪的——近义

例句.英文: However, as researcher Eerang Park and colleagues argue, cities must still create effective marketing strategies to benefit fully from being named a City of Gastronomy.
例句.原书高亮: being named a City of Gastronomy
例句.中文: 然而，正如研究者 Eerang Park 及其同事所指出的，城市仍必须制定有效的营销策略，才能充分受益于被命名为美食之都。

例句.英文: Many people in Buenaventura’s restaurant industry hoped that food tourism would increase after the city was chosen as City of Gastronomy in 2017.
例句.中文: 布埃纳文图拉餐饮业的许多人曾寄望于：2017 年当选「美食之都」后，美食旅游会随之增长。

义项: 动词 gravitate toward / to 被吸引而逐渐靠向（某种气质、群体、立场）
[构词] gravity n. 重力 → gravitate；写作里比 be attracted to 更含蓄、更书面

例句.英文: In the end, that was the temperament I gravitated toward, too.
例句.中文: 说到底，我自己也慢慢倾向了那种气质。

义项: 形容词 可居住的；适于生存的（habitable zone 宜居带）
[构词] habit-（居住）+ -able
搭配说明: habitability / habitat — n. 可居住性 / n. 栖息地
inhabitable — adj. 可居住的；注意：并非 habitable 的反义词
habitable zone (HZ) — 宜居带——真题天文类固定术语

例句.英文: Computer models have determined that for potential hycean planets, the range of the habitable zone (HZ), the distance from a star that allows a planet to retain liquid water on its surface, begins at about 1 astronomical unit (AU).
例句.原书高亮: the range of the habitable zone (HZ)
例句.中文: 计算机模型已确定，对于潜在的氢海洋行星，宜居带（HZ，即行星与恒星之间能使其表面保有液态水的距离范围）的起点大约在1个天文单位（AU）处。

例句.英文: Given the immense scope of space, the search for extraterrestrial life is almost necessarily concentrated on the exoplanets deemed to have the most plausible chance of success—typically, atmosphere-bearing terrestrial planets orbiting within a certain range of their stars (termed the habitable zone).
例句.中文: 鉴于宇宙空间浩瀚无垠，对外星生命的探索几乎必然集中于成功可能性最被看好的系外行星——通常是拥有大气、且在恒星一定距离范围内运行（即所谓宜居带）的类地行星。

义项: 动词 提高；增强（heighten awareness / focus / tension）
[构词] height（高度）+ -en（使）
搭配说明: heightened — adj. 增强的； heightened version 更强化版的自己
heighten ≠ heigten — 注意拼写：height + -en
intensify — v. 加剧——近义

例句.英文: In recent years, architects have heightened their focus on developing eco-conscious and sustainable buildings, as exemplified by Grove Office, a structure conceived by Greenline Architecture.
例句.中文: 近年来，建筑师们愈发把注意力投向具有生态意识、可持续的建筑，由 Greenline Architecture 构思的 Grove Office 便是例证。

例句.英文: When Pheus is in front of an audience, it’s as if he becomes another person, a more heightened version of himself.
例句.中文: 当 Pheus 站在观众面前时，他仿佛变了一个人——成了一个更张扬、更强化版的自己。

义项: 动词 尊崇、敬奉（传统、人物、理念）：怀着深深的敬意对待
词形提示 (引申义) 真题中 4/5 次以 venerated（受尊崇的）出现，作前置定语
[构词] 拉丁 venerari「尊敬、崇拜」
搭配说明: venerated — adj. 受尊崇的——真题高频词形（the venerated republican ideals）
venerable — adj. 令人敬仰的、庄严的（易混拼形）
revere — v. 尊敬（近义，词表可对照）

例句.英文: It wasn't an arbitrary pen name but rather a complex rhetorical strategy through which Thomson aligned his political views with the venerated republican ideals of the ancient world, thereby bolstering the authority of his writing.
例句.原书高亮: the venerated republican ideals of the ancient world
例句.中文: 这并不是一个随意起的笔名，而是一套复杂的修辞策略：汤姆森借此让自己的政治立场与古人所尊崇的共和主义理想相接，从而为自己文章的权威性背书。

义项: 释义 从今以后；今后（正式 / 文学语体）
[辨析] henceforth 多指「从现在起」，但过去叙事中也可指「从那时起」；thenceforth 则明确指「从那时起」
搭配说明: hence — adv. 因此；由此
thenceforth / thereafter — adv. 从那时起——近义
拼形警示 — 与 henceforward 同义；不可写成两个词 hence forward

例句.英文: Vale put her hand to her heart and cried, “Oh, why can’t you remain like this for ever!” This was all that passed between them on the subject, but henceforth Clara knew that she must grow up.
例句.原书高亮: but henceforth Clara knew that she must grow up
例句.中文: 韦尔把手按在胸口喊道：噢，你为什么不能永远这样呢！关于这件事，她们之间只说了这些，但从那以后，克拉拉明白自己必须长大了。

义项: 名词 腹地；内陆地区（城市之外的周边地带）
名词 （港口的）集散腹地——经济地理术语
搭配说明: hinterlands — n.（复数）真题以此形出现
inland / backcountry — n. 内陆 / n. 偏远地区——近义
hinterland ≠ homeland — 形近异义：后者是「祖国」

例句.英文: To investigate the intra-county spatial reorganization that accompanied sectoral shifts during the second wave of industrialization in the United States (a period corresponding to overall population growth), Martin Vogel et al. analyzed census data from 1870 to 1930 for counties that were predominantly rural as of 1870, considering sectoral composition in hinterlands (areas outside cities), incumbent cities (i.e., cities established before 1870), and cities established after 1870.
例句.中文: 为了考察美国第二波工业化期间（这一时期总体人口也在增长）伴随产业结构转型而来的县内空间重组，Martin Vogel 等人分析了1870至1930年间那些在1870年以农业为主的县的人口普查数据，并比较了腹地（城市以外的地区）、既有城市（1870年前已建制的城市）以及1870年后新建城市的产业结构。

义项: 副词 直到此时 / 此时为止（书面语，等于 until now / so far）
副词 a hitherto underutilized source 一个迄今未被充分利用的来源；与 heretofore 同义，均属 SAT 高阶旧式副词

例句.英文: Oliveira and colleagues' 2017 study of the evolutionary trajectory of the Malagasy grass genus Chasechloa instead relied on historical DNA—genomic data incidentally preserved in specimens that are housed in natural history collections—thus capitalizing on the research potential offered by a vast but hitherto relatively underutilized source of insight into the biological past.
例句.原书高亮: vast but hitherto relatively underutilized source
例句.中文: Oliveira 等人 2017 年对马达加斯加禾草属 Chasechloa 演化轨迹的研究，改而依靠历史 DNA——即意外保存在自然史馆藏标本里的基因组数据——从而发掘出一个庞大却迄今相对未被充分利用的、通往生物过去的洞见来源。

义项: 名词 谷壳、种皮、果实外皮（psyllium husk 洋车前子壳）
名词 (引申义) （贬）空壳、只剩躯壳；v. husk 剥去…的外壳

例句.英文: Seeking a biodegradable alternative, Waqas Ahmad and colleagues tended otherwise equivalent plots of strawberries mulched with PE sheeting or one of several newsprint pulp–based alternatives: just newsprint pulp (NP), pulp bound with guar gum (GG), or pulp bound with psyllium husk (PH).
例句.中文: 为寻找可降解的替代方案，Waqas Ahmad 等人照料了其余条件完全相同的草莓地块，分别覆以 PE 薄膜或几种新闻纸浆基材料：纯纸浆（NP）、瓜尔胶黏合纸浆（GG）、洋车前子外壳黏合纸浆（PH）。

例句.英文: At its peak, sweet corn grows a whole inch every single day and as the layers of husk shift slightly to accommodate this expansion, you can hear it as a low continuous rustle if you stand inside the rows of a cornfield on a perfectly still August day.
例句.中文: 甜玉米长势最旺时每天足足长一英寸；苞叶层层微微错动以适应这种膨大——若在八月一个纹丝无风的日子的玉米行间伫立，能听见低低的连绵沙沙声。

义项: 形容词 杰出的；显赫的（an illustrious career / name）
[构词] il-（向内）+ lustr（光）→ 光彩照人
搭配说明: illustrate / illustration — v. 说明 / n. 插图——同根，真题另现
illustrious ≠ illustrate — 前者是形容词「显赫的」，常被误当动词
distinguished / eminent — adj. 卓越的——近义

例句.英文: And then you weren't so illustrious as I hear you've since become.
例句.中文: 再说，那时的你还不像我听说的你后来那样声名显赫。

义项: 形容词 （言行）不客气、多管闲事到失礼的程度
形容词 (引申义) （旧义）不相干的、不切题的；真题 it would have been impertinent to inquire 是英式反讽：追问其政绩近乎失礼

例句.英文: Finally, and adding much-needed gravitas, was Sir Winston Day, whose features seemed moulded to adorn a bust, or possibly a stamp, and whose forehead was so evidently bulging with grey matter that it would have been impertinent to inquire too closely into the actual achievements his half-century of public service had produced.
例句.原书高亮: have been impertinent to inquire too
例句.中文: 最后，同样为场面添上急需的庄重的，是温斯顿·戴爵士：他的相貌仿佛天生就该被塑成半身像、或印上邮票，额头显然鼓胀着灰质，以至于若有人过分细究他半个世纪公职究竟成就了什么，倒显得唐突失礼了。

义项: 形容词 （说法、条件）不合情理、不大可能成立的
[构词] im- + plausible；真题 extreme and implausible environmental conditions 用并列形容词强化否定

例句.英文: Based on simulations they conducted, astrophysicists Daniel Whalen, Muhammad Latif, and colleagues concluded that these early quasars developed partly as a result of rare convergences of gases in space without the need for ultraviolet backgrounds or other extreme and implausible environmental conditions that models of the early universe have included to account for the presence of these quasars.
例句.原书高亮: extreme and implausible environmental conditions that
例句.中文: 基于所做的模拟，天体物理学家 Daniel Whalen、Muhammad Latif 等人得出结论：这些早期类星体的形成，部分源于太空中气体罕见的汇聚，并不需要早期宇宙模型为解释其存在而设定的紫外背景或其他极端且难以成立的环境条件。

义项: 形容词 印象派的；印象式的（impressionistic qualities / style）
形容词 (引申义) 凭印象的；不精确的（常带轻微贬义）
搭配说明: Impressionism / Impressionist — n. 印象派 / n. 印象派画家
impressionistic ≠ impressive — 形近异义：后者是「令人印象深刻的」
impressionable — adj. 易受影响的——同根另一支

例句.英文: But there was room for individuation: Sam Newton's Tangerine Sky, for example, may resemble other Highwaymen paintings at first glance, but his works stand out for their more realistic and less impressionistic qualities.
例句.中文: 但仍留有个人发挥的余地：例如 Sam Newton 的《Tangerine Sky》初看与其他公路客画作相似，但其作品以更写实、更少印象式质感而别具一格。

义项: 形容词 独特的、个人独有的：属于个体特质、因人而异的
名词提示 (引申义) idiosyncrasy n. 个人癖性、独特之处（2099 卷干扰项）
[构词] 希腊 idio-（个人的）+ syn-（共同）+ krasis（混合）→「个人独有的调配」
搭配说明: idiosyncrasy — n. 个人特质、癖性（2026年9月美国A卷 Q4 干扰项）
idio- 前缀家族 — idiom n. 习语、惯用语——同一前缀「个人特有的」

例句.英文: Animal dispersers may congregate at varying distances from parent trees, may carry seeds for varying lengths of time, and may have idiosyncratic spatial trajectories.
例句.中文: 动物传播者可能在距母树远近不一的地方聚集，携带种子的时间长短各异，其活动轨迹也可能各具独特性、彼此不同。

义项: 名词 靛蓝；靛蓝色（深蓝紫色染料）
名词 (引申义) （文学）深蓝、幽蓝的色调描写
搭配说明: indigo ≠ index / indicate — 仅前三个字母相同，义无关
Turbulent Indigo — 真题：Joni Mitchell 1994 年专辑名
crimson / azure — n. 绯红 / n. 天蓝——同域色彩词

例句.英文: For the cover of her album Turbulent Indigo (1994), Mitchell painted a striking self-portrait that closely resembles Vincent van Gogh’s Self-Portrait with Bandaged Ear (1889).
例句.中文: 米切尔为自己1994年的专辑《汹涌的靛蓝》绘制了一幅醒目的自画像，与梵高1889年的《耳朵缠着绷带的自画像》极为相似。

例句.英文: Indigo doesn't dissolve in just water, so manufacturers must mix hazardous chemicals with water to dissolve the powder.
例句.中文: 靛蓝不能单靠水来溶解，因此制造商必须把危险化学品与水混合来溶解这种粉末。

义项: 动词 （害虫、病菌）大量滋生、侵扰（be infested with）
动词 (引申义) 充斥；遍布（常带贬义）
搭配说明: infestation — n. （害虫）侵扰
whitefly-infested plants — 真题复合形容词：受粉虱侵染的植株
infest ≠ infect — 前者是「虫害滋生」，后者是「感染」

例句.英文: Researchers investigated the poor resistance tomato plants show to whitefly herbivory by exposing some plants to airborne chemicals from whitefly‑free plants and others to airborne chemicals from whitefly‑infested plants, then infesting both groups of plants with whiteflies.
例句.原书高亮: then infesting both groups of plants with whiteflies
例句.中文: 研究者考察了番茄植株对粉虱取食表现出较弱抗性的原因：他们把一些植株暴露于无粉虱植株释放的空气化学物质中，另一些暴露于受粉虱侵染植株释放的化学物质中，然后让粉虱侵染两组植株。

义项: 动词 注入；灌输（infuse A with B：把 B 注入 A）
动词 (引申义) 泡（茶、药）；使充满（infuse the text with humor）
搭配说明: infusion — n. 注入；浸剂
infused with metabolites — 真题搭配：注入了代谢产物的
infuse ≠ confuse / suffuse — 形近异义：后者是「弥漫于」

例句.英文: Biotechnology researcher Lina Haddad and team have developed a tool to restore those cues in damaged reefs: a gel coating infused with metabolites derived from Indian Ocean CCA.
例句.原书高亮: a gel coating infused with metabolites
例句.中文: 生物技术研究者 Lina Haddad 及其团队开发了一种工具来恢复受损珊瑚礁中的这些线索：一种注入了源自印度洋壳状珊瑚藻代谢产物的凝胶涂层。

例句.英文: Lead acetate, however, has a much higher water solubility of 44.31 grams per 100 milliliters, so in an experiment intended to address this issue, researchers infused pure water with sodium acetate, which provides acetate ions that readily bond with lead ions to form lead acetate.
例句.中文: 而醋酸铅的水溶性要高得多（每 100 毫升 44.31 克），因此在针对这一问题的实验中，研究者向纯水中加入醋酸钠——其提供的醋酸根离子易与铅离子结合生成醋酸铅。

义项: 形容词 零星的、偶发的：不时出现但不规律、不成连续
反义 constant / continuous 持续的——2049 卷文段以 sporadic…（零星活动）vs dormant（休眠）作对照
搭配说明: sporadically — adv. 零星地（2066 卷：polynyas that sporadically form）
构词 — 希腊 sporadikos「分散的」，与 spore（孢子）同源——「四处散播」

例句.英文: Although 39P/Oterma and 83982 Crantor are both classified as centaur objects—outer solar system bodies in unstable orbits—they exhibit striking differences in behavior: while the object 39P/Oterma is considered an active centaur, showing sporadic comet-like activity (such as clouds of dust and gas on its surface), 83982 Crantor, showing no such activity, is considered dormant.
例句.中文: 尽管 39P/Oterma 与 83982 Crantor 都被归类为半人马型小天体——运行在不稳定轨道上的外太阳系天体——它们的行为表现却截然不同：39P/Oterma 属于活跃型，会零星出现彗星般的活动（比如表面喷出尘埃与气体云）；而 83982 Crantor 毫无此类活动，属于休眠型。

例句.英文: Scientists have long known that cyclones can contribute to the formation of polynyas, large patches of unfrozen water that sporadically form amid vast sheets of sea ice.
例句.中文: 科学家早已知道，气旋能促成冰间湖的形成——那是在大片海冰之间零星出现的开阔未冻水域。

义项: 名词 相互作用；相互影响（the interplay of / between A and B）
[构词] inter-（相互）+ play
搭配说明: interplay ≠ interaction — 前者偏「此消彼长的动态互动」，文学 / 艺术分析常用
interdependent / interdependence — adj. / n. 相互依存的——同族，真题另现
interaction — n. 互动——通用近义

例句.英文: Impressionist painters often focused on the interplay of color and light in their works.
例句.原书高亮: focused on the interplay of color and light in their works
例句.中文: 印象派画家常聚焦于作品中色彩与光的相互作用。

例句.英文: The interplay between opposing ideological positions in Howards End is broadly articulated in the novel's organization of geographic space.
例句.中文: 《霍华德庄园》中对立意识形态立场之间的互动，在小说对地理空间的组织安排中得到了宏观呈现。

义项: 动词 插入；嵌入（interpolate X into Y：把 X 加进 Y）
动词 （在文本中）插入（后人添加的字句）；（数学）插值
搭配说明: interpolation — n. 插入（的内容）；插值
interpolate ≠ interpellate — 形近，后者是哲学/政治术语「询唤」
interject / insert — v. 插话 / v. 插入——近义

例句.英文: … interpolating into them elements of the staging and elaborate choreography of modern dance and classical ballet.
例句.原书高亮: interpolating into them elements of the staging
例句.中文: ……并在其中插入了现代舞与古典芭蕾的场面调度与繁复编排元素。

例句.英文: … when choreographer Amalia Hernández adapted the traditionally participatory dances of Mexico for performance before a passive audience in a theater setting, interpolating into them elements of the staging and elaborate choreography of modern dance and classical ballet.
例句.原书高亮: interpolating into them elements of the staging
例句.中文: ……编舞家 Amalia Hernández 将墨西哥传统上人人参与的舞蹈改编为剧场中面向静坐观众的演出，并向其中注入现代舞与古典芭蕾的舞台调度与繁复编舞。

义项: 形容词 色彩与形状纷繁变幻、不断重组的
[构词] kaleidoscope n. 万花筒 → kaleidoscopic adj.；常形容作品拼贴多元来源

例句.英文: Drawing on knowledge of everything from East African fabrics to Arabic calligraphy, Uman’s kaleidoscopic paintings often combine abstract shapes with anthropomorphic elements, like eyes, mouths, and gestures.
例句.中文: Uman 的画作汲取东非织物乃至阿拉伯书法等种种知识，常把抽象形状与眼睛、嘴巴、手势之类拟人元素并置，呈现出万花筒般的面貌。

义项: 动词 哀叹；为…悲痛（lament the passing of / that…）
名词 挽歌；悲叹（a lament for the dead）
搭配说明: lamentable — adj. 令人遗憾的；可悲的
lamentation — n. 悲叹；哀悼
lament ≠ lambent — 形近异义：后者是「（光）轻柔摇曳的」

例句.英文: Though less widely known, Picasso—who once lamented that writers of his time had “limited themselves to moving around words somewhat while respecting the syntax”—also wrote poetry that defied conventional grammar, semantic relationships, and text structure.
例句.原书高亮: who once lamented that writers of his time
例句.中文: 尽管鲜为人知，毕加索——他曾慨叹自己时代的作家只是把词挪来挪去，同时还要遵守句法——也写过挑战常规语法、语义关系与文本结构的诗。

义项: 形容词 无力、迟缓而懒散的；（火光、光线）渐弱将熄
[辨析] 与 livid、zenith、ravel 同出一段散文诗，SAT 文学题常要求按上下文判定义项而非词典首义

例句.英文: … the sun, already down, was manifest in the livid tongues of fire darting towards the zenith, falling and darting again, ever more pale and languid …
例句.中文: ……已落下的太阳，化作一片片青灰色的火舌朝天顶窜去，落下又窜起，愈见苍白、愈见慵倦……

义项: 名词 larks 云雀；与 buzzards（鵟）对举，泛指鸣禽
名词 (引申义) 嬉戏、玩笑（for a lark）；v. lark about 胡闹

例句.英文: From larks to buzzards, many birds fly in flocks.
例句.中文: 从云雀到鵟，许多鸟类都成群飞行。

例句.英文: The Song of the Lark, painted in the realist style by Jules Breton, depicts a barefoot peasant woman pausing in the fields at sunset.
例句.中文: 《云雀之歌》由朱尔·布雷东以现实主义风格绘成，描绘了一位赤脚农妇在日落时分的田野中驻足的情景。

义项: 名词 自由化（economic / trade / market liberalization）
名词 （市场、资本）放开管制——真题经济类文章高频
搭配说明: liberalize — v. 使自由化——真题动词形，另现
liberal / liberality — adj. 自由的 / n. 慷慨；开明
liberalization ≠ liberalisation — 英式拼写，SAT 用美式 -z-

例句.英文: The standard view among economists at the time was that liberalization would make it easier for companies to raise money from investors.
例句.原书高亮: liberalization would make it easier for companies to raise money
例句.中文: 当时经济学家的标准看法是，自由化会让企业更容易从投资者那里筹资。

例句.英文: In an analysis of economic data from 1976 to 1993, Ross Levine and Sara Zervos found that liberalization did not lead to enduring increases in investment in companies based in countries that liberalized.
例句.中文: 在对 1976 至 1993 年经济数据的分析中，Ross Levine 与 Sara Zervos 发现：金融自由化并未使自由化国家的本土公司投资出现持久增长。

义项: 名词 （书面）面部轮廓、特征；常复数 lineaments
名词 (引申义) （抽象事物的）基本面貌、脉络；真题 her immortal lineaments 把「自然」拟人化

例句.英文: He had partially unveiled the face of Nature, but her immortal lineaments were still a wonder and a mystery.
例句.原书高亮: her immortal lineaments were still a
例句.中文: 他已揭开自然面纱的一角，可她那不朽的眉目，依旧是奇迹，也依旧是谜。
